steps.say: Stock builds up when we ship more into the channel than it sells, so I'll compare sell-in with sell-out for every model in Q3.

args.query: channel stock sell-in sell-out by model

args.title: Where channel stock grew in Q3
args.subtitle: Channel stock at the end of June and September, units.

steps.answer:
**Egypt's Galaxy A37 is the one to act on: its channel stock more than doubled in Q3, from 24,092 to 58,675 units, because we shipped 34,583 more than the channel sold.**

[{chart}]

**Also rising**
- **Galaxy A57 in Saudi Arabia:** up 45%, to 53,254 units [{stock}]. Sell-in ran 16,634 ahead of sell-out [{models}].
- **Galaxy A17 in Morocco:** up 94%, to 16,044 units [{stock}].

**Expected, not a concern**
- The UAE's new Galaxy Z Flip8 and Z Fold8 hold their first launch stock (7,995 and 2,767 units).
- Every other model moved by less than 3% [{stock}].

Egypt's sell-through rate fell from 72.9% to 67.6% this quarter [{quarterly}]. **Suggested next step:** slow Galaxy A37 shipments to Egypt until the channel works through its stock.
